dct_description_sm: Base compiled from USGS 1:24,000-scale topographic maps dated 1950-1977, map edited 1978, revised from aerial photographs taken 1973 and 1975; interpretations derived from soil map constructed 1979. "Projection and 10 000-meter grid ticks, zone 15, Universal Transverse Mercator." "25 000-foot grid ticks based on Illinois coordinate system, west zone." May 1980. Includes location map.
